segments.ja395:1.3: Sukatā [sukatāya (sī. pī.)] massukuttiyā, sobhate vata me sakhā.
segments.ja395:2.3: Cirassaṃ nhāpitaṃ laddhā, lomaṃ taṃ ajjaṃ hārayiṃ [apahārayiṃ (sī. pī.)].
segments.ja395:3.1: Yaṃ nu lomaṃ ahāresi, dullabhaṃ laddha kappakaṃ;
segments.ja395:3.3: Atha kiñcarahi te samma, kaṇṭhe kiṇikiṇāyati [idaṃ kaṇṭhe kiṇāyati (ka.), kaṇṭhe kiṃnikilāyati (syā.)].
segments.ja395:4.3: Tesāhaṃ anusikkhāmi, mā tvaṃ maññi davā kataṃ.
segments.ja395:5.3: Kārayissāmi te samma, maṇiñcāpi dadāmi te.
segments.ja395:6.1: Tvaññeva maṇinā channo, sukatāya ca massuyā;
segments.ja395:6.3: Āmanta kho taṃ gacchāmi, piyaṃ me tava dassananti.
segments.ja395:9.1: Atha passa sasūci ca tuṇḍilako, miga mayhakapañcamapakkhivaro;
segments.ja395:9.3: Atha pañjali vārija mejjha puna, atha vaṭṭa kapotavarena dasāti.
segments.ja395:11.3: Avāriyā ca kharo ca [senaka (sī.), sūci ca (syā. ka.)], dve ca vuttā subyañjanāti.
